channel.description: Press releases and breaking news, Tampa Bay

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Tampa police search for man who escaped court-ordered health care facility
item.description: Tampa police are searching for a 36-year-old man who escaped from a court-ordered health care facility Monday evening and are urging the public not to approach him if he is seen.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Sarasota County teacher loses home after lightning strike starts a fire
item.description: A Sarasota County teacher and her family lose nearly everything in a house fire. Firefighters said the fire started from a lightning strike.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Beach Park Tampa development: Residents oppose proposed 11-story tower
item.description: A proposed mixed-use tower is drawing mounting pushback from homeowners in Beach Park, who argue the project would overwhelm their local streets. Neighbors are organizing petitions and public campaigns asking city officials to scale back the project ahead of an upcoming public hearing.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] How to protect yourself before stepping into a rideshare vehicle
item.description: A deadly deputy-involved shooting in Polk County is raising questions about rideshare background checks and passenger safety.
